summary: The same chart-image equality (atlas `A.ofBaseSet h` / its one-form atlas vs `A`) is rebuilt six times as hand-written `.trans`/`congrArg SetLike.coe`/`.symm` chains even though every lemma involved is `@[simp]`. Two zero-one-form membership proofs also duplicate each other.
